title: Research construction: signed CK reuse saves 926 primitives
head: 72899c888af7e171f8aba4d5c66f4b31a5719eba
body:
Finite complex-supplier construction on the historical #626 CK provider; no new kappa claim.

Saves 926 forward real-component primitives beyond same-domain positive-read reuse with accepted PR696 copy resets. No additional backward saving.

**Admitted into a fresh PR626 replay; kappa unchanged.** After `scripts/verify_frontier626.py` passes, `admission.py`:
1. confirms the CK native inputs (programs, checks, native replay) are byte-identical, so the native frame/wrapper admission covers the unchanged event stream;
2. confirms coefficient work is two dedicated physical registers, so the longer work live range needs no new hosting;
3. re-issues the retained invoice with the signed CK counts; every strict check passes;
4. confirms the CK fractional depth (8 bits; forward rises 3→4, backward already 8) and the global prefix (286 of 512 bits) are unchanged;
5. reruns the retained assembly and admission controls, reproducing kappa `51110230636731/31250000000000000` exactly.

Only the CK contract and local-recount SPEC pins are replaced; kappa, profile, hash and control-count pins are kept. Selected scalar recount: 18,263,888 → 17,530,324 real-component primitives (includes predecessor savings; 926 are due to signed reads). Not a contribution to the current #799 X4 frontier.

Base: f567884. Reproduce:
```
python3 -I -B research/ck-signed-coefficient-routes/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/verify_frontier626.py --work /tmp/f626
python3 -B research/ck-signed-coefficient-routes/admission.py --work /tmp/f626 --out /tmp/f626-signed
```

Also verified: 725 columns, 1,080,288 route cases, 15 negative controls (each must fail with its stated reason), exact fractional depth cross-checked by a second integer-only implementation, six package tests, and selected-record integrity. Both implementations are AI-written and share the cost model and inputs. All-size, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain inherited.

Full evidence, source pins, predecessor credit and limitations: research/ck-signed-coefficient-routes/README.md

Prepared for AmazedBot with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; precision check, control tightening and PR626 admission added with Claude. No independent human review is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
